 Five Things to Know: Badgers wrap up homestand vs. Coastal Carolina
 November 13, 2026 | Men's Basketball
 Share: UW and CCU to meet Sunday at 7 p.m.
 By: AJ Harrison 
 MADISON, Wis. —   The Wisconsin men’s basketball team finishes its stretch of home games as it is set to host Coastal Carolina on Sunday night. Tip at the Kohl Center is set for 7 p.m. 
 Sunday’s game will air live on Big Ten Network as Zach Mackey and former Badger standout Jordan Taylor will be on the call. Fans can also listen to the Badger Radio Network as Matt Lepay and Badger legend Brian Butch will be on the mic. 
 A night for the ?? https://t.co/DNLz5SUMSl
— Wisconsin Basketball (@BadgerMBB) November 11, 2026 LAST TIME OUT
 The men’s basketball team blew past Fairfield, 89-42, on Tuesday night at the Kohl Center. Austin Rapp and Braeden Carrington led Wisconsin (3-0) for their third win of the season, in a game where four players scored double-digit points. Rapp led the team with 15 points and 6 rebounds, cashing three from beyond the arc. Carrington and Owen Foxwell tacked on 14 points each, while Foxwell led the team with three assists. The dominant win was Wisconsin’s highest margin of victory (47) since 2016. 
 Austin Rapp RAPP READY TO ROLL 
   Austin Rapp was firing on all cylinders on Tuesday night, scoring a season-high 15 points and grabbing six rebounds from off the bench. Rapp was great from beyond the arc, with a .429 3-point field goal percentage that is tied for second-highest on the season from any player. Rapp also led the team with a +38 plus/minus rating. 
 PAIR OF CAREER-HIGHS 
 Will Garlock and Zach Kinziger both achieved career-highs in points, with Garlock scoring eight and Kinziger tallying seven. Garlock made all four of his field goal attempts and added four rebounds as he posted the second-highest plus/minus rating of +32. Along with his seven points, Kinziger had two assists and two steals. 
 Jalen Brown BROWN, ANN TO JOIN BADGERS
 The Wisconsin men's basketball announced  that guards Jalen Brown and Baboucarr Ann will join the program.  
 A 6-5 guard from Milwaukee, Brown is a consensus four-star recruit and top-100 recruit in the country. After spending three seasons playing for Wauwatosa West High School, Brown is currently playing for Sequoia National Prep in Mesa, Arizona.  
 During his junior season at Wauwatosa West, Brown averaged 20.5 points, 7.2 rebounds, 6.2 assists and 2.9 steals. As a sophomore he helped the Trojans win the state title while averaging 22.1 points, 7.3 rebounds and 5.2 assists per contest.  
A 6-5 guard from Maple Grove, Minnesota, Ann is a consensus four-star recruit and is tabbed as a top-100 recruit and the No. 1-ranked recruit in the state of Minnesota per 247Sports.
 Ann has starred at Maple Grove High School, averaging 18.9 points, 4.3 rebounds, 3.5 assists and 1.4 steals per game last year for the Crimson. The guard set a school record with a 47-point performance, breaking the previous record of 42 set by former Badger standout and current Special Assistant to the Head Coach Brad Davison .
 Nigel Hayes had 15 points, 8 rebounds and 3 assists against Coastal Carolina AGAINST THE CHANTICLEERS
 Sunday marks the fourth meeting between the Badgers and Chanticleers, who are located in Conway, South Carolina. UW is undefeated in the all-time series, with their last meeting being an 86-72 win on March 20, 2015 in the first round of the NCAA Tournament in Omaha, Neb. Frank Kaminsky posted 27 points and 12 rebounds, while Sam Dekker had 20 points and two assists.
